text: Patch 21006 is live. Draft a short checklist for Jake to test the automatic Welcome Pack on a fresh character. Check the bag before talking to an NPC and again after relog. Expected totals: two of each Tier I-V Sovereign Order, 999 Portal Scrolls, 999 Portal Charms, and one bound each of Crafting Unlock, Crafting Mastery, Soulstone Key and Chi of Purity. Send actual counts as a report after he tests. Until then label the result pending.

Lead timer is active. The server passed its 26-file readiness check and an isolated client patched to 21006 with all 7,920 managed files verified. Jake's helper setup is tracked in issue #1. Actual in-game starter counts still need a playtest.

Live follow-up: after Jake reconnected, the server logged a successful automatic Welcome grant on johnf and the remaining 998 Portal Charms twelve seconds later. Please still check the visible bag and verify a relog gives no duplicate items.

V26 and client patch 21007 are staged at Dean's request. Live remains V25 / 21006. Offline audit verified eight camps across four maps, 120 Sentinel spawns, guide travel, and four tokens per ten credited kills. The level-table model gives 4h48m from 135 to 150 at 25 credited kills/minute. Actual combat pace and simultaneous farming await a future live test. No tester action yet.

V25 / patch 21006 is back online after recovery. All eight production services and 26 release files passed. A local Jade Dynasty client entered Sunstream City with an existing level-135 character and logged out normally. Jake's remote connection, visible Welcome Pack counts and duplicate-free relog still need his playtest. V26 / 21007 remains staged.

Patch 21008 is live. On the configured tester client, run Start PJD.cmd. A separate 21006 installation updated from the public feed and all 7,924 managed entries passed verification. The login screen has an animated jade gate and waterfalls. The optional Windows launcher icon add-on is linked in patcher news. Pre-ascension Forsaken Abyss Sentinel rewards are 10x across all four training bands. The level table models 60 credited kills from level 1 to 150. A fresh timed run and laptop visual check are pending. Ascended training keeps its previous rewards. All eight server services and all 28 installed content files passed readiness. The staged Sleepless camps were excluded.

Patch 21009 is live on the normal PJD update feed. A separate 21008 tester updated successfully and all 7,932 managed entries passed. The normal desktop client also installed the eight new skin members. This is a shared model replacement for the Balo Cracking Axe and Rayan Blood Carnage Scythe and other items using the same art. The test leaves equipped item stats and refinement values intact. After updating both clients, check whether a second character sees the new weapon and whether the refinement glow follows the blade during attacks. Two-PC visibility, glow alignment and the desktop freeze are still gameplay checks.

V27 / client 21009, affinity and Chroma playtest handoff. Installed quest and item data on both sides confirm The Divination from Tanis Ka at ascended level 90 and the affinity-specific Vitalization route at 120. Sovereign Orders 55886 through 55890 grant the five native Tribulation awards at full Chroma EXP at levels 9, 18, 27, 36 and 45. Item 55885 is the separate Vitalization shortcut. Gameplay checks are pending for each affinity, item consumption on refusal, breakthrough, active story quests and persistence after relog. Distribution is still open. This was a read-only investigation.

V28 staged against live V27 / client patch 21009. Sovereign Orders 6, 7 and 8 are items 64556, 64557 and 64558, linked to quests 60356, 60357 and 60358. Each uses the fifth order breakthrough and requires full Chroma EXP at exactly 54, 63 or 72 respectively. Offline release review and 18 native eligibility cases per side passed. After a future deployment, check item counts before and after early use, valid use, duplicate use and relog. In-game results and distribution are pending.

Live release: V28 Tribulation Orders 6-8 and the V29 Tanis Ka affinity choice are on the normal client feed, patch 21011. Eight services and all 30 installed release files passed readiness. An isolated native client verified 7,933 managed entries and the normal desktop client reached 21011. For the playtest, speak to Tanis Ka at ascended level 90+, open Choose Your Affinity, choose Dagos, Felkin or Fuwa, and confirm. At ascended 120+, use Sovereign Order: Vitalization after affinity selection. Each Tribulation Order requires full Chroma EXP at its matching multiple of nine, through 72. Gameplay confirmation of choice, breakthrough, consumption and relog is pending.

V30 and client patch 21012 are live. On 21011 both test characters saw Invalid quest at Join for all three affinities. Tanis Ka was missing the three branch IDs in his offer list. The offline quest check reproduces all three rejections on 21011 and accepts all three on 21012. All eight server services, 30 installed files and 7,933 managed client entries passed. Dean confirmed the Vitalization scroll worked. Each designated test character received 9,999 bound Chroma Beads by mail for exchange at the Elder of Arcaneness. After updating, choose the intended affinity at Tanis Ka and check the character sheet again after relog. In-game affinity awards and Tribulation breakthroughs at full EXP on Chroma 54, 63 and 72 still need playtesting.

V31 / client 21013 is live. Dean confirmed the 21012 Tanis Ka affinity shortcut worked. At the Sunstream PJD Test Supplier, Supply now offers loose bound Affinity and Chroma Beads, free 9,999-bead packs, the four scripture books and both gold packs. The regular donation beads stack to 32,767. The Elder of Arcaneness now also appears near Tanis Ka at X159/Z143 with his native donation quests. Eight services, 30 installed files and 7,933 client entries passed verification. Still pending in game: purchase/open a pack, donate each bead type, and verify the matching orders at full Chroma EXP on 54, 63 and 72 and after relog.

V31 / patch 21013 playtest update. Dean reported that everything he tested worked, specifically confirming Tribulation Orders 6, 7 and 8 in game. Individual EXP values, consumption counts and a separate relog result were not recorded. The overnight lead mailbox timer has been removed from the lead PC. Manual handoffs are available.

V32 / patch 21014 is live. Eight services, 31 installed files and 7,933 managed client entries passed verification. The PJD shops now have shop-only menus. The free supplier carries beads, banknote packs and the insignia. The token merchant stocks books, jades, Perfect Talismans, Vajra buff, Gold VIP, pets, six native skyblades and the one-time training items. Relic Upgrades combines trinkets and Chi on one page and directly sells ten Eternal Fatecharms. The game help places the first Fatecharm slot at ascended 150. All new token offers cost one. Native costs total 404,250 Expertise for seven rank-12 skills. The six-mastery aptitude lesson passed 18 offline Lua cases. Still pending in game: confirm purchases, inspect F.Charm on an eligible character, redeem the Expertise grant, and activate all six crafting aptitudes before learning and crafting Aptitude Lesson once and ranking up. Check persistence after relog.

V33 / patch 21015 is live. All six Fatecharm slots unlock together at Asc. 135. Both level caps verified at 150. The seven Expertise skills can now be ranked without a disciple, and the Aptitude Training Pass has a gold certificate icon. Dean already confirmed the Fatecharm purchase, Expertise grant and Aptitude craft on 21014. All eight services, 34 installed files and 7,935 managed client entries passed. The native updater applied 21015 and the patched client reached server selection. Pending gameplay on an Asc. 135 character: equip six different Fatecharm attributes, verify the stat changes after relog, and spend 25 Expertise on a first rank without a disciple. The remote PC should run its usual PJD launcher before testing.

V33 / client 21015 playtest correction. Dean confirmed Fatecharms work. Clicking an Expertise plus still returned Unable to learn current skill. The running world had loaded the stock skill library. The corrected rules passed an isolated first-rank test for Path of Masters at level 135 with 25 Expertise and no disciple. The server startup correction is staged and awaits the restart. Live rank purchase and persistence are pending.

V33 / client 21015. The server restarted and the running world now loads the corrected Expertise library. All 34 files and eight services passed readiness, with both level caps at 150 and rates at 5x EXP, 2x money and 2x drops. The first Path of Masters rank passed an offline check at level 135 with 25 Expertise and no disciple. Buying the rank in game and checking it after relog are pending. Existing 21015 clients can reconnect.

Live V33 / client 21015: Dean confirmed Expertise now works in game. No separate relog result was reported. Staged for a future batch: the free nine-destination Astrolabe and seven-day recharger, plus an offline-tested Firmus-only King of Mediums change that preserves Spirit growth. These drafts have not been deployed.

Staged against V33 / client 21015 for a future batch. PJD Relic Upgrades in Sunstream has a draft Gems tab with 48 level-5 Perfect gems, all 12 socket types in each family, and a Sockets tab with the standard Socket Lock and Reforge Stone. Each offer costs one PJD Token and delivers one item. Both client and server shop records passed offline readback alongside the free Astrolabe draft. Live gameplay and purchases await deployment.

Staged against V33 / client 21015 for a future batch. The Sunstream free supplier is at (167,113), Elder of Arcaneness at (167,111), and PJD Token Merchant at (167,109) in the draft. Verified walkable ground, original shared facing, and exact preservation of map data outside the three positions. Deployment and in-game selection are pending. Check the Elder can be clicked from the street because Tao Danush has a higher spawn at the same map coordinates.

V33 / client 21015 draft update. PJD Relic Upgrades now stands at (167,115) beside the free supplier at (167,113) in the staged Sunstream map. All four positions, walkable ground and shared facing passed offline checks. In-game checks await deployment.

V33 / client 21015 offline draft. The PJD Token Merchant Gear tab lists Lv8 Open Star Seal Pack (64600) and Lv8 Closed Star Seal Pack (64601) at one PJD Token per outer pack. Checked both staged data files against the native elemental forge offers. Each outer pack grants four gear packs and each contains all five corresponding elemental seals. Both paths cover 40 unique level 8 seals. Purchases and opening the nested bags in game await deployment.

Server V34 and public patch 21016 are live. All 35 files and eight services passed readiness. Caps are 150 and rates are 5x EXP / 2x money / 2x drops. The isolated client verified 7,935 entries. PJD Play reached 21016. Sunstream X167 row runs from Z109 Token Merchant (Gear has both one-token Lv8 seal packs, Goods has King of Mediums) to Z111 Elder, Z113 free supplier (Astrolabe and recharger) and Z115 Relic Upgrades (Charms offers 5,000 fragments per token or one Heavenly Elixir, Gems has 48 Perfect gems, Sockets has lock and reforge). Native trade tests passed. Live gameplay checks pending for pack opening, Fatecharm removal, NPC selection, gems, Astrolabe use and Firmus Spirit preservation.

Live V35 / patch 21017. Dean confirmed both nested seal packs work in game on V34. Open and Closed now use outline and solid stars; gear packs use actual equipment icons. Five zero-coin purchases at Sunstream free supplier (167,113) passed the native offline vendor check: Magewool 4012, Arcane Wool 13904, Firmus 43475, PJD Esper Catalyst 64610 and PJD Tangon Jade 64611. Catalyst grants 315200 Esper proficiency subject to native caps. One Jade matched the nine ordinary Tangon stones on both fresh and partially extended Firmus in Lua 5.1 tests. Test Catalyze and Assimilate separately in game. King of Mediums has an additional secondary Esper requirement (19523) for the Firmus resistance path. Server readiness passed all 36 files, eight services and both level-150 caps. Public feed and all 7935 managed test-client entries verified; PJD Play updated. Live tests for the new Esper items and icon visuals are pending.

V35 / 21017 Firmus playtest. One level 30 Divined secondary Esper (19523) was delivered to bigdaddy by system mail and its attachment was verified in the mailbox. Claim and bloodsmelting results are pending. The test uses Firmus as primary, 19523 as secondary and King of Mediums as the medium.

V35 / 21017 Firmus playtest. Three additional separate mails each carried one level-30 Divined Esper (19523) to bigdaddy. All three attachments were verified in the mailbox. Claim and bloodsmelting results are pending. The colored seal-pack icons are next after the checkpoint.

V35 / client 21017 playtest: Dean reported three King of Mediums attempts with level-30 fodder. An offline replay confirmed the shared 450-grade limit can stop all further gains while individual stats are still below cap. An offline Firmus-only draft for King of Mediums plus secondary 19523 caps all five resistance growths, HP and upper attack, sets Spirit and lower attack growth to grade one, and grants the 27 additional grades required. Offline Lua tests covered a fresh growth profile, a previously stalled Firmus, rebuild from stored values, repeat refusal, locked inputs, ingredient routing, and an unchanged control Esper. The consumable tooltip describes the trade. Ten colored seal icons also passed an offline 36px atlas readback. Neither draft has been deployed. Pending gameplay after release: compare the tooltip before and after one smelt, verify item counts on a repeated attempt and stats after relog, and check both seal-pack rows. Remote Courier is a separate feasibility investigation.

V36 / public client patch 21018 is live. Each of 76 combat Esper templates now has enough shared growth for all nine individual maxima, including the reborn bonus. Existing Espers gain room for ordinary bloodsmelting. King of Mediums 22017 plus Divined Esper 19523 as secondary fills the primary combat Esper in one smelt. The earlier low-Spirit/min-attack proposal was superseded. Ten colored Open/Closed seal-pack icons and the King tooltip are also live. Offline Lua checks covered all 76 normal and reborn templates, 1368 last-stat cases, a normal bloodsmelt through the dispatcher, and repeat refusal. After the world save and restart, all eight services and 36 installed files passed. The public feed and 7935 managed entries passed native updater verification. Playtest on 21018: compare all nine stats before/after, especially Spirit and minimum attack, check stats after relog, and check item counts on a repeat. In-game consumption and persistence await player confirmation.

V37 / client patch 21019 is live. Sunstream PJD Test Supplier (167, 113), Supply slot 15 next to PJD Tangon Jade, now sells the level-30 Divined Esper for zero coins. At the Esper Mystic, use the combat Esper you want to keep as primary, the Divined Esper as secondary and King of Mediums as medium. This maxes the nine growths and fills all six bonus skill slots. It preserves existing skills and their unlock levels. Offline checks passed for all 76 combat Espers, including an already growth-maxed primary, and the native shop initialization produced level 30 and Divined quality in 32 rolls. The world restarted, all eight services and 36 installed files passed, the public feed matched, and the native updater verified 7935 entries. Pending in-game checks are a free purchase, one smelt, existing skills and stats after relog, and item counts on a repeat. The minimap mail icon still uses the existing notification behavior in 21019.

V37 / public patch 21019. Dean confirmed that the King of Mediums smelt worked in game. A new level-34 Esper reached 202 displayed resistance despite starting with higher base resistance than a previous Esper. The reason for the difference is pending. V38 is prepared for maintenance. The proposed PJD Green Stat Orb in free Supply slot 16 at Sunstream (167, 113) trains Health, Spirit and Attack in one Assimilate. Offline tests passed the zero-coin shop checkout and the native Lua stat rebuild for all 75 eligible combat templates. Pending after release are the player purchase, one assimilation and green bonus persistence after relog. The public client is still on 21019.

V38 / public patch 21020 is live. The world saved, restarted, and passed readiness on all eight services and 36 managed files. The native updater verified 7935 client entries and the PJD Play copy has the zero-coin PJD Green Stat Orb (64612) in Sunstream PJD Test Supplier (167, 113), Supply slot 16 beside the Divined Esper. The offline audit passed for 75 eligible combat templates. For the gameplay check, buy one, use Assimilate at an Esper Mystic with Firmus, and check the green bonuses again after relog. Expected on a level-34 non-reborn Firmus are 6800 Health, 6800 Spirit and 1020 Attack. Player purchase, consumption and persistence are pending.

V38 / client 21020 playtest update. Dean confirmed the PJD Green Stat Orb worked on Firmus in game. Exact displayed values, green bonuses after a normal relog and orb consumption on a repeat attempt remain unreported. The level-34 resistance comparison remains a separate balance follow-up.

V38 / 21020 Firmus comparison resolved. A read-only comparison reproduced all five saved resistances on each of two level-34 non-reborn Firmuses. The King-trained example reached the 6.06 cap on every resistance. Five per-Esper rolls assigned at creation explain why identical trained growth and starting base can still yield a seven-point display difference. The Green Stat Orb affects Health, Spirit and Attack. Gameplay relog and repeat-use checks are still pending.

V39 / client 21021 is live. Shura (-240, -444) has six Baseline Shura Riders with 486,030 template HP and 20-second respawns. The camp starts Shura Rider Baseline, a 24-hour quest with 1 gold and 50 million EXP per credited Rider. Native offline tests passed zero, two, 43 and extended-session reward amounts. All 39 installed files, eight services, public feed and 7,936 PJD Play entries passed verification. Gameplay checks pending: automatic pickup, two kills then trash for 2g and 100m EXP, one fresh tracker, and expiry. No timed farming sample yet.

V39 / client 21021 gameplay check passed in Shura. The camp automatically delivered the 24-hour tracker to a level-135 ascended Rayan. Two Riders credited two kills, and trashing paid 2 gold and 100 million EXP in chat. One fresh 24-hour tracker immediately showed zero. Native Invigorate then killed and looted three more Riders without manual targeting. The first two kill-to-kill intervals were 45 and 44 seconds, and the bag gained one PJD Token during those three kills. The sample is ongoing. Natural expiry at 24 hours remains untested.

V39 / 21021 timed Shura cashout: 191 Riders in 2h 8m, 191 gold and 9.55 billion quest EXP, 80 collected PJD Tokens and 212 recipe scrolls. V40 / 21022 is staged for maintenance. The test Rider pays 5 gold and 50 million EXP on the quest, drops one PJD Token per kill and has an independent 10 percent Sunny Jade chance. The Sunstream free supplier has Max Common Orb and Max Advanced Orb in Supply slots 17 and 18 on the staged build. Each fills its six character Orb Forging bonuses on right-click. Offline checks covered the 191-kill payout, both death triggers, both free purchases and using both items on empty, partial and capped progress. Live gameplay and relog checks for V40 are pending. The server and public client remain on V39 / 21021.

V40 / client patch 21022 is live. The world restarted and all eight services and 39 installed files passed readiness checks. The public feed and updated playing client passed verification of the changed payloads and 7,936 managed client entries respectively. In-game checks pending: get the free Max Common Orb and Max Advanced Orb from the Sunstream PJD Test Supplier (167, 113), Supply slots 17 and 18. Right-click each, check its six character Orb Forging bonuses, and check them again after a normal relog. In Shura (-240, -444), start the tracker at zero, kill two Baseline Shura Riders and trash the quest. The offline check returned 10 gold and 100 million EXP. Check for one fresh tracker, one PJD Token per Rider, and an independent 10 percent chance of one Sunny Jade over a longer sample. Natural 24-hour expiry is also pending.

V40 / client 21022 playtest update. Both Max Orbs worked in game. The player observed increased Rider gold and Sunny Jade drops. A pickup sample contained both PJD Tokens and Sunny Jades. The geared 12.9k AP +11 Rayan reported over ten uses of Dragon Cut II with Ultima to kill a Baseline Rider. For tier tuning, live Shura has level-135 Shura Initiates near (-371, -205), level-147 regular Shura Riders near (169, 321), and the existing Baseline camp at (-240, -444). Regular versus Baseline Rider template HP is 16,201 versus 486,030, both with 1,781 defense. Proposed gameplay comparison: starter +9 Arden/Vim single-target timings and Modo/Jadeon single-target and AoE pack throughput. Those class timings, post-relog Orb Forging bonuses, and an exact V40 cashout and tracker regrant are pending.

V41 / client 21023 is live. The world restarted, 41 installed files and eight services passed, and the updated PJD Play client verified all 7,937 managed entries. The six later-tier Baseline Rider spawns match V40. Ascended level 135–150: get free +9 gear and take First Orders from Caravan Outrider, Sunstream (170, 138), before using its ride. Report to Caravan Scout in Shura (314, -180). The one-time awards are 200 for reporting, 100 for three supply packs, 100 for either route (three north plus three south pickets or two lieutenants), and 100 for the signal-fire captain. Signal fire at (370, -172). After the finale the scout offers both routes as repeatable 5-gold contracts. Both serialized quest packs, NPC service IDs and linkage, the supply-pack probability, summons and reward definitions passed offline checks. In-game acceptance, payouts, relog and +9 Jadeon/Vim times on both routes are pending.

V42 / native patch 21024 is live. Dean reported the V41 caravan worked. All 43 installed files and eight services passed after restart, and PJD Play verified 7,938 managed entries. Nine caravan quest records now use native tracker prompts and directions plus clickable locations for the Outrider, Scout, Signal Fire, raiders, both picket groups, west and east lieutenants, and the summoned captain. Eight entity IDs resolve in each travel index. Reversing only the navigation changes reproduced the prior quest records, including progress and reward definitions. Gameplay checks pending: accept a contract or reopen an in-progress quest, inspect the tracker, click a mob and turn-in NPC to walk, and confirm a Portal Charm takes the player to the selected target and consumes one charm. The existing Outrider dialogue ride is still free.

V43 / patch 21025 is live. The world loaded Imperial Citadel, all eight services and all 47 installed files passed, and the playing client verified 7,939 managed entries. Lonzan in Sunstream (189,126) has the stock 80g ride. All 93 farm areas retain their original centers and extents and now hold five. Test ascended 135-139 Garuda Archers (2g and 100m quest EXP per credited kill), 140-144 Odious Cavaliers (3g and 150m), 145-149 Lucifuge Knights (4g and 225m), and 150 Knights (4g). Check automatic tracker, two-kill trash payout, regrant, level transition, +9 Vim/Jadeon throughput. Farm bonus drops are one token, 10% Sunny Jade and 2% Harmony Rune. Sunstream Token Merchant Goods exchanges a Rune for 100 tokens or six Event Marks for one chosen max orb. Siege courtyard (70,0) opens every even UTC hour for 25 minutes. Two-account playtest pending: separate parties earn Vanguard and Marshal credit, boss clears, one cache per eligible account arrives by mail, open cache for one Mark and tokens. Also test support credit, switching characters and late arrivals. Event roll, repeat processing and native exchanges passed offline. Four daily PvP events, other hourly slots and Shura Gauntlet work are on the roadmap.

V44 / client 21026 is live. Confirmed in both quest packs that the Imperial Citadel ride checks level 120+, active Chroma level 1-81 and 80 gold. Lonzan in Sunstream (189,126) and the PJD Test Supplier (167,113) each have a free Chroma tab with Sovereign Order: Vitalization, followed by Tribulation 1-8. All 18 purchases passed the native offline vendor check at zero gold. Original item-to-quest links were verified. The world restarted, all eight services and 47 files passed, and PJD Play verified 7,939 entries. Gameplay check pending: on a fresh ascended 135, choose affinity at Tanis Ka, buy and use Vitalization, confirm Chroma level 1, then take the 80g ride from Lonzan into Imperial Citadel.

V44 / client 21026 Citadel balance playtest. Dean reports eight Mohun uses and approximately 18 seconds of sustained single-target combat for a Garuda Archer on the Vim. All three live farming tiers have 151,250 template HP. An offline Archer-only trial at 60,500 HP passed client/server readback and whole-file reversal. The estimate at the observed pace is about seven seconds and three to four uses. The live world retains V44 values. Pending comparison after any tuning release: five Archers on the same Vim, then a five-mob Jadeon pack, with target-switch and respawn time recorded separately.

V45 / client 21027 is live. The Caravan Outrider in Sunstream (170, 138) offers Claim a Caravan Soulstone once per ascended character at level 135 or higher. Accepting starts a 30-day timer. The bound level 16 stone arrives by system mail on the one-minute reward cycle. Native offline checks read eight max-grade lines and verified equip eligibility. The world restarted empty, all eight services and 47 installed files passed, and PJD Play verified all 7,939 managed entries. Gameplay checks pending on a tester character: claim once, collect and equip, confirm the deadline and displayed lines, then relog and check that a second claim is unavailable.

V45 / client 21027 playtest update. A player completed the Outrider claim. The server recorded Your Caravan Soulstone with an attachment in the recipient mailbox seven seconds after completion. The attachment was still awaiting collection at verification. Pickup, equipped stats and equipped expiry remain pending gameplay checks.

V45 / client 21027 Archer balance playtest. Dean reports about 10 seconds per Garuda Archer on Vim with the Caravan Soulstone equipped and a maxed Attack Fatecharm. In the three-minute server window following the prior Archer cashout, 17 monster awards totaled 56,212,200 EXP. The next cashout directly credited 1.7 billion EXP and logged 34 gold for 17 kills. Combined EXP was 1,756,212,200. A full ascended 135 to 136 projects to about 18 minutes at this camp pace, before cashout overhead. The Jadeon comparison remains open.

V45 / client 21027. The player confirmed 17 Archers in three minutes and a level 135 EXP bar change from 25.18% to 41.23%. The 16.05-point jump matches the 1.7 billion EXP quest payout. At a hypothetical 2,720 kills the native award calculation passed 272 billion EXP and 5,440 gold in an offline check. No overnight run or retained character EXP at that scale has been observed.

V46 / client 21028 is live. The new Citadel Gate Warden stands at Sunstream (194, 120) beside Lonzan (189, 126). The Warden now offers the original 80g Imperial Citadel ride, quest 21364, with the same level 120 and Chroma 1–81 requirements and both original arrivals. Lonzan retains his Chroma shop and 34 other offers. The game-native Warden has a 16-bone rig and is three times stock Caravan Outrider height. Three animation clips passed 123 frames of offline deformation checks. The world restarted empty, 54 installed files and eight services passed readiness, all ten published downloads matched, and PJD Play verified 7,945 managed entries including all five custom model resources. Pending player observations are size beside an avatar, idle and talk appearance, selection range and the actual 80g trip from the Warden.

Live 21028 playtest: Dean supplied a screenshot of vimtest beside the visible Citadel Gate Warden. It confirms placement and rendering and shows blurred armor at conversation distance. The actual 80g ride is still unconfirmed. A client-only V47 art candidate is prepared for review. Offline native-skin and DDS comparisons verified dedicated front and rear UVs, painted side views, three 2048 textures, identical oriented triangles, vertex normals and skin weights. Compare the jade eyes, gold shoulder spirals and bell lettering from the same in-game camera after publication. No world restart is required.

Gate Warden client patch 21029 is live. The signed increment from 21028 downloads four art files totaling 5,678,770 bytes. All four public payloads matched the release and the native PJD Play updater installed them. All 7,947 managed client entries passed verification. The world stayed online throughout. In-game comparison is pending at Sunstream (194, 120), especially the jade eyes, shoulder spirals and chest engraving beside vimtest.

V47 / client 21029 Gate Warden playtest. Dean confirmed the improved artwork in game at the Sunstream gate and observed no visible ground shadow. Both shadow options are enabled in the playing client. An offline alternative enables shadow casting and retains the three action names and loop settings. A separate offline 2x height variant was compared with the live 3x Warden. The new size, ground shadow and 80g ride still need gameplay verification. This playtest produced no new public patch.

V48 / client 21030 is live. White Tiger Elder (64672) stands at Sunstream (194, 114), six units from the Citadel Gate Warden. He is twice the stock Outrider height and has a 15-bone rig, refreshed axe-hand and armor-side art, and a five-second breathing idle. Native deformation checks covered 210 frames across three actions, including static boots, grip and axe. The world restarted empty. All 65 installed files, eight services, 11 changed public downloads and 7,956 playing-client entries passed verification. The existing Warden ride is preserved. An in-game visual check of his grip, side armor, scale and idle is pending.

V48 / 21030 playtest. Dean saw the Elder in Sunstream and liked the overall appearance but reported a distorted face and apparent duplicates. Cause unconfirmed. Stock NPC models are preferred for future work. Dean also reported failed teleports to both Citadel siege targets. Installed playing-client index points to Vanguard (66, -4) and Marshal (70, 0) in world 26. The siege window was closed when checked. Portal Charm behavior during an active window remains unverified.

V48 / client 21030 Citadel playtest. The server recorded the manual siege activation at 23:20 server time, and Dean confirmed the mobs spawned. Scheduled reward eligibility was outside this combat test. Dean also counted 30 Garuda Archers in four minutes on a less-geared Jadeon versus 17 in three minutes on Vim, about 32 percent more kills per minute in these two runs.

V48 / client 21030 follow-up. Verified successful Vanguard and Marshal objectives on vimtest in the manual siege. At the Marshal kill, vimtest and AthanQA3 each received 2,407,960 combat EXP. The objective awarded zero extra EXP and zero gold. The out-of-window kill produced no cache claim or siege mail. Scheduled cache delivery is still pending a gameplay test.

V49 / client 21031 is live. The world saved and restarted at zero connections. Citadel terrain loaded, all eight services and 65 managed installation files passed readiness, and PJD Play verified 7,956 entries. Sunstream Lonzan (189, 126) has the original 80g Citadel ride again. The Gate Warden and White Tiger Elder were removed. Inside Citadel, all four Benwolf locations now offer Defend the Citadel to ascended levels 135-150. Try Benwolf at (12, -10), then the siege courtyard at (70, 0). Vanguards use Yinshen General and the Marshal uses Overlord of Chaos. Pending gameplay checks: ride and exit service, manual signup, both models in combat, Vanguard and Marshal party credit, and one mailed cache per eligible account during a scheduled clear.

V49 / client 21031 playtest. Dean confirmed he picked up Defend the Citadel from Benwolf in game. A scheduled clear, cache delivery and opening, and the new models in combat still await gameplay confirmation.

V49 / client 21031 siege playtest. Dean stood at Citadel (70, 0) during the scheduled midnight server window and saw an empty courtyard. All 12 installed siege controllers mark their start and stop times invalid. The game loader skips both timers, which explains the earlier successful manual spawn and the missing automatic spawn. Clearing those two flags per controller in memory let the native game clock recognize all 12 starts and 12 stops across 72 checks. The correction awaits release. An automatic spawn, scheduled clear and mailed rewards still need gameplay verification.
